1.

Product Overview

Detect early. Alert instantly. Save lives — 24/7 protection through continuous monitoring and immediate response.

The Fire Alarm System is designed to protect life and property by providing early fire detection and instant alerts. It ensures quick evacuation and helps reduce risk and damage.

The system continuously monitors the environment through detectors. When fire is detected, it activates alarm devices to alert people and sends a signal to the control panel for immediate response.

Ideal for all types of commercial, industrial and residential applications — available in conventional and addressable configurations, scalable from 2 to 128 zones.

Early Fire Detection

Advanced sensors detect smoke, heat or fire at the earliest stage.

Instant Alert

Sounders and strobes give instant alarm to alert occupants.

Zone Monitoring

Multiple zones for easy monitoring and identification of fire location.

Event Logs & Reports

Stores all events, alarms and faults with detailed reports.

3.

System Components

Nine core components that make up a complete fire detection and alarm installation.

01

Fire Alarm Control Panel

The central unit that monitors all zones, processes detector signals and triggers alarm devices with LED indication for fire, fault, power and zone.

→
02

Smoke Detectors

Optical / photoelectric detectors that sense smoke particles at the earliest stage of a developing fire.

→
03

Heat Detectors

Fixed temperature and rate-of-rise detectors for areas where smoke detection is unsuitable.

→
04

Manual Call Points

Easy-to-operate break-glass units for immediate manual fire alarm activation. Available resettable or non-resettable.

→
05

Sounders / Horns

Audible alarm devices that alert occupants throughout the protected premises.

→
06

Strobe Lights / Flashers

Visual alarm indication for noisy environments and hearing-impaired occupants.

→
07

Input / Output Modules

Interface modules for integrating third-party equipment and building safety systems.

→
08

Power Supply with Battery Backup

Ensures uninterrupted operation during mains failure — 24 hours standby, 30 minutes in alarm.

→
09

Cables & Accessories

Project-specific wiring, conduits and mounting accessories for a complete installation.

→
